assessments.reasoning: The separate declaration and handler subsections both state immediate propagation out of the originating block. Examples distinguish enclosing handlers from an otherwise matching handler in the originating block.

challenge.method: Compare declaration examples 11-16 and 11-17 and handler counterexample 11-21 with a normal executable-phase local handler.
challenge.results: Declaration and handler exceptions bypass handlers of their own block. The examples distinguish an enclosing handler and an otherwise matching second handler of the same block.

limitations: These phase boundaries leave final error handling, rollback, and implementation propagation across remote database calls outside the claim.
